https://telex.hu/after/2026/08/25/meghal.text: Menü Kereső Meghalt Dolly Parton After Fotó: Rick Kern / WireImage / Getty Images Szente Katica Nyolcvanéves korában meghalt a countrysztár Dolly Parton. Az énekesnő legutolsó Las Vegas-i koncertjeit már elhalasztotta az egészségi állapota miatt . Azt nem indokolta meg, pontosan milyen egészségügyi panasz miatt kell elhalasztania a koncerteket, rá jellemző módon elviccelte az ügyet: „Viccelődtem velük, hogy itt lehet az ideje a százezer mérföldes felülvizsgálatnak, bár ez nem a szokásos kirándulásom a plasztikai sebészemhez” – magyarázta. Dolly Parton testvére már jelezte korábban, hogy rosszabbodott az énekesnő állapota, és mindenkit arra kért, hogy imádkozzanak érte. A halálát Bryan Seaver, Cassie Parton fia, Dolly Parton unokaöccse jelentette be a közösségi médiában. Dolly Parton Primetime Emmy-, valamint többszörös Grammy-díjas amerikai country- és popénekesnő az amerikai Tennessee államban született egy szegény, tizenkét gyermekes család negyedik gyermekeként. Édesanyja énekelt és gitározott, az édesapja is játszott bendzsón, de Parton a zene iránt való érdeklődését nagybátyjának, Bill Owensnek tulajdonította. Első dalát is nagybátyjával szerezte tizenegy évesen, ez volt a Girl Left Alone. Tizenhárom éves korában találkozott először Johnny Cashsel, aki bátorította őt az énekesi pályára, miután George Jones „You Gotta Be My Baby” című dalát hallhatta Partontól Nashville-ben. Az igazi áttörést az 1974-ben kiadott Jolene című dal hozta meg Dolly Parton számára, amit keresztlánya, Miley Cyrus is feldolgozott – a videó már 500 millió megtekintés fölött jár YouTube-on. Dolly Parton I Will Always Love You című dala listavezető lett, még Elvis Presley is fel akarta dolgozni, de annak fejében, ha az énekesnő lemond a szerzői jogokról, amibe Parton már nem ment bele. Évekkel később, 1992-ben Whitney Houston viszont feldolgozta 1974-es I Will Always Love You című dalát, ami viszont világszinten ismert lett. Here You Come Again című albuma volt az első 1977-ben, ami átlépte az egymillió eladott lemezt, 1978-ban pedig elnyerte első Grammy-díját. Első filmje a Kilenctől ötig volt (1980), amit Colin Higgins rendezett, a film dala, a 9 to 5 Golden Globe- és Oscar-díj jelölést is hozott számára. Férjével hat évtizeden keresztül szerették egymást, Carl Dean 2025 márciusában halt meg. „Hatvan éven keresztül voltam vele, úgyhogy újra kell tanulnom a dolgokat, amiket együtt csináltunk” – nyilatkozta férje haláláról a CNN-nek . „Megnyugtat, hogy békében van, de ez nem akadályoz meg abban, hogy szeressem őt, és hiányozzon nekem” – mondta. Házasságukat mindvégig megtartották maguknak, nem mutatkoztak nyilvánosan, sőt Dolly Parton azt is elmondta, hogy férje mindig vett magának jegyet a koncertjeire, nem akarta, hogy valamit csak azért kapjon meg, mert ő a híres countryénekes férje. http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/0.text: Several incendiary devices were set off during the night outside Munich-based technology group Rohde & Schwarz and German drone manufacturer Helsing.Investigators currently believe that two of the devices ignited, while the third apparently did not.A witness called the police at around midnight after incendiary devices were thrown from a moving car at a building site on the street.Officers who arrived at the scene were able to extinguish the fire immediately. No major damage was reported.The suspects, a 38-year-old man and a 28-year-old woman, were then arrested. According to German public broadcaster Bayerischer Rundfunk, both suspects are Bulgarian nationals.Rohde & Schwarz manufactures, among other things, security and communications technology for public authorities and the military. Helsing mainly produces drones for military operations. REUTERS/Brian Snyder/ File Photo Image: Reuters/Brian Snyder world Trump says progress made toward establishing U.S. Army base in Poland Sep. 18 05:15 am JST Sep. 18 | 12:14 pm JST 20 Comments WASHINGTON President Donald Trump said on Thursday that progress is being made ‌toward establishing a US Army base in Poland, crediting "the bold leadership" of Polish President Karol Nawrocki. "If this happens, ‌the location will be announced ⁠very soon. This will be a ⁠historic step ⁠for our Great U.S./Polish Alliance," Trump said ‌in a post on Truth Social. Nawrocki later thanked ⁠Trump on ⁠X, saying that Poland was "ready to continue our efforts to strengthen our defense cooperation," and adding: "I can assure you that the Polish ⁠government will do its utmost ⁠to provide the best possible location ‌for the U.S. Army base." The head of the Polish president's chancellery, Zbigniew Bogucki, called it "great news for Poland," underscoring that it ‌came on the 87th anniversary of Soviet Russia's invasion of Poland. Poland has been pushing for a bigger allied presence on NATO's eastern flank after Russia's invasion of neighboring Ukraine in 2022. In June, Polish Defense Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz ​said the U.S. Department of Defense was open to Poland's offer to host ‌a permanent U.S. military presence in Poland, but that no decision had been taken. The minister met with U.S. Defense ‌Secretary Pete Hegseth in June in Brussels, ⁠where the Pentagon ⁠chief announced a new ​review of US troop deployments in Europe. Poland ⁠has so ‌far hosted U.S. troops on a ​rotational basis. © Thomson Reuters 2026. ©2026 GPlusMedia Inc. https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/20/trum.text: US President Donald Trump said Monday he is willing to sit down with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in China next month, confirming media reports that the three leaders could meet on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific summit in Shenzhen.Trump said such a summit would centre on denuclearisation but might also touch on the war in Ukraine.Asked by reporters whether he would join Putin and Xi to discuss Ukraine, Trump downplayed that as the main draw. “I would do it, not so much for Ukraine, because Russia, frankly, has been fine with Ukraine. They haven’t been doing much,” he said. “We would have it to talk about nuclear weapons and denuclearisation.”Pressed on whether Ukraine would come up at a meeting with the two leaders, Trump said he would do “whatever I can do to end the war".Beijing says it has no details while Kyiv insists on involvementEarlier, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said, "Given that all three heads of state might potentially attend a summit in China, the topic of such a hypothetical meeting has indeed been mentioned."The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) group holds a summit in the Chinese city of Shenzhen on 18-19 November. China, Russia and the United States are all members.But Peskov added that "no substantive proposals or agreements, neither regarding the meeting itself nor its potential agenda and content, have been discussed or put forward by anyone".China's foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said she had no information about a possible meeting while Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha bristled at the suggestion of a meeting without Kyiv."A trilateral meeting between the leaders of Russia, China and the US would do only the opposite: encourage Putin to continue this war," he said.Putin, he insisted on social media, was "not a global leader; he is a war criminal".The Kremlin's Peskov said that "a final settlement is impossible without the participation of someone from Kyiv who is prepared to take on the responsibility".But Putin has repeatedly ruled out meeting Zelenskyy until after a final peace deal is ready and has repeatedly questioned Zelenskyy's authority to sign a deal following the expiry of his five-year term under martial law.Trump, who has renewed his swipes at Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in recent days, on Monday said it was “time for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine.”"Zelenskyy doesn't know what he's talking about," Trump said when asked about the Ukrainian's comments. "To be honest, I think it's time for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine."
